KEYBIND_HOTBAR: Use the item in quick slot {0}
PROMPT_DROP: Open the items on the ground
INV_ERR_BUSY: Wait until the last action finishes
INV_ERR_DENIED: You are not allowed to open this
INV_ERR_GONE: That item is not there any more
INV_ERR_HAS_COMPONENT: The weapon already has this attachment
INV_ERR_HEAVY: That is too heavy to carry
INV_ERR_IN_VEHICLE: You cannot drop items in a vehicle
INV_ERR_MISSING: You do not have the materials
INV_ERR_MONEY: You do not have enough money
INV_ERR_NOT_FIT: This does not fit the weapon in your hands
INV_ERR_NO_AMMO: You have no ammo for this weapon
INV_ERR_NO_SPACE: There is no room for that
INV_ERR_NO_WEAPON: You are not holding a weapon
INV_ERR_TARGET_FULL: They have no room for that
UI_GROUND_HINT: Drag an item here to put it on the ground
UI_ROTATE_HINT: R turns the item while dragging
UI_QUICK_SLOTS: Keys 1-5 use the first five cells
ADMIN_TAB_ITEMS_DESC: Every item that exists in the game: its name, size in the grid, weight and what using it does.
ADMIN_TAB_SHOPS_DESC: Places where players buy items for money.
ADMIN_TAB_STASHES_DESC: Storage boxes at fixed places, shared or one per character, open to everyone or to some jobs.
ADMIN_TAB_BENCHES_DESC: Benches where players turn materials into items.
ADMIN_TAB_SETTINGS_DESC: How big the inventories of players, the ground and vehicles are.
ADMIN_C_ITEM_DESC: The name players see and what kind of item it is.
ADMIN_C_SIZE_DESC: How many cells the item takes in the grid and how heavy it is.
ADMIN_C_USE_DESC: What happens when a player uses the item.
ADMIN_C_SHOP_DESC: Where the shop is and who may buy there.
ADMIN_C_PRODUCTS_DESC: Items the shop sells and their price per unit.
ADMIN_C_STASH_DESC: Where the stash is, who may open it and how big it is.
ADMIN_C_BENCH_DESC: Where the bench is and who may use it.
ADMIN_C_RECIPES_DESC: What the bench makes, from which materials and how long it takes.
ADMIN_C_DROP_DESC: Items players put on the ground.
ADMIN_H_TYPE: Weapons are held when used, ammo reloads the held weapon, attachments go on it.
ADMIN_H_IMAGE: File name in the inventory's images folder (water.png) or a full https link. Empty shows an icon.
ADMIN_H_ALIASES: Names other scripts use for this item (for example pistol_ammo), so they still work.
ADMIN_H_WIDTH: Cells from left to right; height is cells from top to bottom. Players can turn an item while dragging it.
ADMIN_H_STACK: Most units in one stack. 1 makes every unit separate, for items with their own data.
ADMIN_H_USABLE: Off: using does nothing unless a script handles this item.
ADMIN_H_CONSUME: Units removed each time it is used. 0 keeps it.
ADMIN_H_CLOSE: Closes the inventory screen when the item is used.
ADMIN_H_USE_TIME: How long the animation plays before the item takes effect.
ADMIN_H_STATUS: Added to the player's needs when used (minus lowers them). Needs a HUD that tracks them.
ADMIN_H_AMMO: Item name the weapon loads (for example ammo-9).
ADMIN_H_THROWABLE: Grenades and the like: the stack count is the ammo.
ADMIN_H_COMPONENTS: GTA component names this attachment can be (COMPONENT_AT_PI_FLSH); the first one the held weapon takes is used.
ADMIN_H_COORDS: Stand where players should open it and use your position.
ADMIN_H_RADIUS: How close a player must be to open it.
ADMIN_H_JOBS: Empty lets everyone in; otherwise only characters with one of these jobs.
ADMIN_H_GANGS: Characters in one of these gangs may open it too.
ADMIN_H_BLIP: Shows the shop on the map.
ADMIN_H_ACCOUNTS: Money accounts tried in order (cash, bank).
ADMIN_H_PERSONAL: On: every character has its own contents. Off: everyone who may open it shares one.
ADMIN_H_ROWS: Rows of cells; the width is the Columns setting.
ADMIN_H_COLUMNS: Cells per row in every inventory. Changing it with items stored can push items out of place.
ADMIN_H_DESPAWN: Items on the ground disappear when nobody touched them for this long.
ADMIN_DELETE_ITEM_DESC: Players who have it keep a stack nobody can use.
ADMIN_DELETE_STASH_DESC: Items stored in it stay in the database.
